text:
If your Thursday plans can handle a mostly gray sky, you’re in decent shape, but keep a light rain jacket nearby after 2. Burlington should stay mostly dry, with a stray shower possible through the afternoon and a high near 76. The forecast spread is wider than usual, from the mid 70s to around 78, but the bigger message is that this is not shaping up as a washout. Winds stay light, and the lake should be calm, with waves around 1 to 2 feet. Any shower risk fades this evening, with clouds thinning overnight and a low near 57.

Friday is the cleaner day, sunny with a high around 70, though northwest winds build to 5 to 15 knots and the lake gets a little livelier. Plan outdoor time freely today, but keep the afternoon flexible, and aim for the waterfront Friday morning or early afternoon before the breeze picks up.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Thursday! Thursday features clouds and a few rain showers, with the bulk of any rain across the southern half of the area. The farther north you are and the closer to the international border, the drier it will be. High temperatures are climbing back into the upper 60s to lower 70s for Thursday afternoon. Rain wraps up this evening, and skies clear overnight as lows dip into the lower to mid-50s.
